---
params:
  Common_name: "petrale sole"
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
  
  species_name <- params$Common_name
  section_name <- firstup(species_name)
  wcgbt_years = c(2003:2019, 2021:2025)
  hkl_years = c(2004:2019, 2021:2025)
  
  sub_data <- data |>
    dplyr::filter(Common_name == species_name)
  sources <- get_source(data = sub_data)
  data_to_show <- unique(sub_data$sources_to_use)
  assess <- assess_data_df |>
    dplyr::filter(species == species_name)
  ass_yr <- ifelse(
    is.na(assess$year) & assess$type == "data-limited",
    2010,
    assess$year
  )
  if (
    assess$type %in% c("benchmark", "update", "data-moderate", "data-limited")
  ) {
    a_an <- ifelse(assess$type == "update", "an", "a")
    assess_text <- glue::glue(
      'The most recent assessment of {species_name} ',
      'was {a_an} {assess$type} assessment conducted in {ass_yr}. '
    ) 
  } else {
    assess_text <- glue::glue(
      'To date, no assessment or analysis has been conducted on {species_name}. '
    )
  }
  
  obs_text <- glue::glue(
    "Across available data, {species_name} ",
    "have been observed and sampled by"
  )
  if (data_to_show == "all") {
    survey_text <- glue::glue("{obs_text} both the NWFSC WCGBT and HKL surveys. ") 
  }
  if (data_to_show == "wcgbt") {
     survey_text <- glue::glue("{obs_text} the NWFSC WCGBT survey. ") 
  }
  if (data_to_show == "hkl") {
     survey_text <- glue::glue("{obs_text} the NWFSC HKL survey. ")
  }
  
  average_sets <- sub_data |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      n = dplyr::case_when(
        Source == "NWFSC WCGBTS" ~ length(wcgbt_years),
        Source == "NWFSC HKL" ~ length(hkl_years)
      )
    ) |>
    dplyr::group_by(Source) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      y = unique(n),
      total = sum(set_tows),
      sets = round(sum(set_tows) / y, 0)
    ) |>
    dplyr::ungroup()
  sample_text <- ""
  for (ss in average_sets$Source) {
    number <- average_sets[average_sets$Source == ss, "sets"]
    if (number > 3) {
      samples <- glue::glue(
        "The {ss} survey has an average of {number} positive tows per year."
      )
      sample_text <- glue::glue("{sample_text} {samples}")
    }
  }
  # Get maturity
  mat <- maturity |>
    dplyr::filter(Species == species_name)
  if (dim(mat)[1] != 0) {
    count <- mat$Count
    read <- mat$Read
  } else {
    count <- 0
    read <- 0
  }
    
  mat_text <- glue::glue("Across the coast a total of {count} maturity samples have been collected with {read} read maturities.")
  
  research_text <- research_list(species_name = species_name)
  
  total_text <- glue::glue("{assess_text} {survey_text} {sample_text} {mat_text} {research_text}")

```

    dplyr::group_by(State, Source) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      Lengths = sum(total_lengths),
      Ages = sum(total_ages),
      `Age Structures` = sum(total_otoliths)
    ) |>
    as.data.frame()

  caption <- glue::glue(
    'Total number of available lengths, read ages, and unread age structures by data source and
 	state between for {species_name}.'
  )
  sa4ss::table_format(
    x = total,
    caption = caption,
    digits = 0,
    format.args = list(big.mark = ",", scientific = FALSE),
    custom_width = TRUE,
    col_to_adjust = 1:5,
    width = c('2cm', '3.5cm', '2cm', '2cm', '2cm'),
    align = 'r'
  )
